name: marquee-schema
description: Source of truth for the Marquee project schema — shared by MarqueeDataKit (Swift/GRDB) and MarqueeStudioWeb (JS/sql.js).

scripts.reference: cd tools/swift-reference && swift run refgen create ../../test/fixtures/reference.db && sqlite3 ../../test/fixtures/reference.db 'PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);'
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run verify
scripts.test:full: npm test && npm run swift:build && npm run roundtrip
